<b>Skull Brutes</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are large [[Skull Scuttlers]] that use huge, horned skulls, charging at intruders to protect their territory and smaller kin.<ref>Skull Brute [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Soft bug beneath a huge, horned skull. Charges at intruders to protect its territory and its smaller companions."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Skull Brutes pretend to be skulls until [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] gets close, after which their skulls shake and they pop out of the ground fully. They move back and forth on their platforms, turning at edges or when they meet a wall. They charge towards Hornet if they see her.

Skull Brutes deal {{damage|2}} on contact, even when they have not emerged from hiding. Being wary of any large skulls on the ground or memorising which skulls are Skull Brutes can prevent suddenly getting hit.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Skull Brutes have their health doubled. They gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Skull Brutes can be found primarily in [[the Marrow]], but they also appear in the [[Deep Docks]] and the [[Memorium]].
